{"id":"mimid-1wgh.53","title":"Hub: host rooms without frank_aad or base_room_policy (franking and policy are SHOULD); keep both as defaults","description":"Implements decision mimid-1wgh.52 (Mark, 2026-11-14). Today Hub::create_room refuses a group whose safe_aad does not require frank_aad (HubError::FrankAadNotRequired, decision mimid-1wgh.6.74) or that lacks a valid base_room_policy (HubError::MissingBaseRoomPolicy, mimid-1wgh.6.57), and update/submit refuse everything in a room without a usable base_room_policy (hub/update.rs, hub/submit.rs 'defence in depth').

Change:
- create_room: accept a group without frank_aad required, and without base_room_policy. Still refuse a base_room_policy that is present but malformed (wire strictness), and a franking_agent that is present but names someone else.
- Rooms without frank_aad: messages are accepted without hub franking; reportAbuse for that room answers that franks are unavailable (pick the code; record it). Log once per room at INFO that franking is off.
- Rooms without base_room_policy: authorize as an open room (any participant may send, add, leave), matching room-policy-04 defaults as far as they go; log once per room at INFO.
- mimid-chat /host and the future Room/create keep setting both by default.
- Tests: hub_foundation's create_room_requires_frank_aad_in_safe_aad and the missing-policy tests become 'hosted without' tests; new tests that messages flow and abuse reports answer the chosen code in a room without franking; a room without policy accepts Add/leave/send.
Decisions needed from Mark before coding: the reportAbuse answer for an unfranked room; whether a deployment setting can turn the old requirements back on.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"task","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-11-14T20:04:40.345006524Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-11-14T20:04:40.345006524Z","labels":["interop","strictness","franking","room-policy"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"mimid-1wgh.53","depends_on_id":"mimid-1wgh","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-11-14T20:04:40.37941817Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","metadata":"{}"}]}
new_value: {"notes":"Decisions by Mark, 2026-11-14:\n(1) reportAbuse in a room without franking: accept with 200 and store the report (reporter, alleged abuser, reason, note); any attached messages are stored flagged as unverified, so a moderator knows they are the reporter's word, not proof. In a franked room nothing changes: a frank that does not verify is still 422.\n(2) Deployment switch: config keys require_franking and require_room_policy, both default false. When true, create_room refuses a group without frank_aad required / without a valid base_room_policy, as before (decisions mimid-1wgh.6.74, 6.57 restored for that deployment). Tests cover both settings."}
